newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines to start scripless share trading Jan 9.
newsitem.headline: Philippines to start scripless share trading Jan 9.

text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) will start the shift to scripless trading on January 9, PSE president Vitaliano Nanagas II said on Wednesday.
"The operation of the central depository will start tomorrow," Nanagas said in a interview to a private television station.

He said the depository will be getting certificates of Jollibee Food Corp for safekeeping. In their stead, confirmation receipts from the Philippines Central Depository Inc will be issued when investors trade in it.
The depository will eventually include other issues.
Nanagas said a scripless trading environment will shorten the settlement of trades to only four days and boost volume turnover in the bourse.
At present, investors get their stock certificates 20 to 27 days after the trade.
